Meet The Founder

Led with a vision for graceful modern jewellery.


“18 years old. A student today. A jewellery entrepreneur in the making. Dreaming big, designing bigger.”

Hi, I’m Aagna Ankit Shah, founder of Seramore Jewels. At 18, while pursuing my BBA in Jewellery Management, I’m turning a lifelong passion for jewellery into a meaningful journey. I’ve always been fascinated by how jewellery can capture emotions, memories, and personal stories, inspiring me to learn, design, and create pieces that hold lasting significance.

Seramore Jewels is the beginning of that dream—a brand built on creativity, craftsmanship, and purpose. Through thoughtfully designed, modern, and timeless jewellery, I aim to create pieces that people truly connect with. As a young entrepreneur, I bring fresh ideas, curiosity, and a commitment to growing with every step of this journey. Thank you for being a part of it.

02
About the Company

Seramore Jewels, crafted in Surat for a refined jewellery experience.

Seramore Jewels was born from a simple belief—jewellery should feel personal. We create timeless pieces designed to be worn, loved, and lived in every day. Whether it’s your first diamond, a meaningful gift, or a piece chosen to celebrate yourself, every jewel carries a story worth cherishing.

As a direct-to-customer brand, we offer fine jewellery crafted in 14kt and 18kt gold with ethically sourced natural and lab-grown diamonds, without unnecessary markups. Alongside our curated collections, we specialize in made-to-order designs, creating beautiful, high-quality pieces that reflect your unique style and become part of your everyday moments.

Behind The Craft

A skilled jewellery team shaping every detail by hand.

A cleaner behind-the-scenes section showing the hands, tools and care that shape Seramore’s jewellery before each piece is presented.

Hand Detailing

Each piece begins with careful hands and patient attention.

From tiny edges to delicate settings, the team works slowly and precisely so every jewel feels refined before it reaches the final stage.

Workshop Team

Polished by experienced makers.

The finishing team brings shine, smoothness and proportion to each design with focused bench work and machine-assisted polishing.

Quality Check

Every sparkle is checked before presentation.

Stone alignment, surface finish and overall look are reviewed closely so the piece feels premium, balanced and ready to wear.

Fine Finish

Small details create the luxury feel.

The final polish adds clarity and softness to the design, turning raw craftsmanship into jewellery that feels elegant and complete.

Trust

Made visible so customers can trust the process.

Showing the making process helps visitors understand the care behind Seramore’s jewellery — not just the final shine, but the effort behind it.

Skilled Hands Jewellery is handled with care at every stage, from detailing to finishing.
